class_id: an exchange 'no link' treated as settled skips the publisher's own rung
feature: document discovery rung chain (document-discovery-runner.ts), any document type the exchanges are not the publisher of once the issue has closed (final Prospectus, basis-of-allotment advertisement)
symptom: a source that answered 'I have no link' is read as 'the document does not exist yet', so the rungs that actually publish the document (SEBI, the issuer's site) are skipped. Because the type is DUE at that stage, the miss counter then escalates the row to BLOCKED_ALL, so the stored state says 'every source failed' while the chain says 'nobody needed to be asked'. Universal shape: a non-publisher's absence is not evidence of absence; only the publisher's answer settles it, and a state derived from a chain must not contradict the chain.
